FUNCTION S_PARA_INT_TYPEPOOL_GET
  IMPORTING
    VALUE(IV_TYPENAME) TYPE TTYPENAME
  EXPORTING
    VALUE(EV_TYPEPOOL) TYPE PROGNAME
  EXCEPTIONS
    EX_NO_TYPEPOOL.




  DATA: L_REPSOURCE  TYPE RSSOURCE OCCURS 0,

        L_INCL_TMP   TYPE PROGNAME,
        L_NAME       TYPE TTYPENAME.
  DATA: L_RETCODE    LIKE SY-SUBRC.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <F>.

  L_NAME = IV_TYPENAME.
  CLEAR L_RETCODE.

  IF L_NAME CA '_' AND SY-FDPOS LE 5.
    L_INCLUDE = L_INCL_TMP = L_NAME(SY-FDPOS).
    SHIFT L_INCL_TMP LEFT BY SY-FDPOS PLACES.
    IF L_INCL_TMP CN SPACE.
      L_RETCODE = 4.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  EV_TYPEPOOL = L_INCLUDE.
  CONCATENATE '%_C' L_INCLUDE INTO L_INCLUDE.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM TRDIR WHERE NAME = L_INCLUDE.

  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    RAISE EX_NO_TYPEPOOL.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ REPORT L_INCLUDE INTO L_REPSOURCE.
  SCAN ABAP-SOURCE L_REPSOURCE
       TOKENS     INTO L_TOKENS
       STATEMENTS INTO L_STATEMENTS
       WITH    INCLUDES
       WITHOUT TRMAC.

  IF L_NAME CA '-'.
    L_NAME = L_NAME(SY-FDPOS).
  ENDIF.

  L_RETCODE = 4.

  LOOP AT L_STATEMENTS.

    ADD 1 TO L_STATEMENTS-FROM.
    READ TABLE L_TOKENS INDEX L_STATEMENTS-FROM.
    IF L_TOKENS-STR = 'BEGIN'.
      ADD 2 TO L_STATEMENTS-FROM.
      READ TABLE L_TOKENS INDEX L_STATEMENTS-FROM.
    ENDIF.

    IF L_TOKENS-STR CA '('.
      ASSIGN L_TOKENS-STR(SY-FDPOS) TO <F>.
      IF <F> = L_NAME.
        CLEAR L_RETCODE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      IF L_TOKENS-STR = L_NAME.
        CLEAR L_RETCODE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF L_RETCODE NE 0.
    RAISE EX_NO_TYPEPOOL.
  ENDIF.

ENDFUNCTION.
